description: This line plot illustrates how coverage changes with the number of completions (k) for four different models: Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT. The x-axis, labeled “Number of completions (k)”, uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 2^0 to 2^5, with tick marks at each power of two. The y-axis, labeled “Coverage”, is linear and ranges from 0.4 to 0.8. The blue line with circle markers represents Llama-3B, starting at a coverage of 0.4 at k=1 and rising to 0.88 at k=32. The green line with triangle markers represents Llama-3B + FT, starting at 0.4 at k=1 and increasing to 0.88 at k=32. The light blue line with diamond markers represents Llama-1B, starting at 0.2 at k=1 and rising to 0.82 at k=32. The light green line with cross markers represents Llama-1B + FT, starting at 0.2 at k=1 and increasing to 0.84 at k=32. All four lines show an increasing trend in coverage as k increases, with the Llama-3B and Llama-3B + FT models achieving higher coverage than the Llama-1B and Llama-1B + FT models at the same k values.
